name: The parts working as one whole
vision_statement: The parts of the system work as one whole: each part knows its role, what the system claims matches its evidence, its records match its code, and one call builds the parts from configuration.
opportunities: A system can check itself, each part can state what it is for, and every part can share one measured way of asking a model, none of which the assembly alone asks for. Whoever builds on the hub gets the integration without writing it.
solution_coherence: The Self keeps the parts of the system working as one whole, and Role Understanding states what each part is for so that no part does another's work. The Assembler builds the whole from configuration in one call and answers a request with the arms the hub selected, and it asks Integrity whether the hub still stays generic, with claims that match evidence and records that match code.
